title: GTA 6: Rockstar Games and Netflix Collaborate for a Special Reveal
description: The highly anticipated video game Grand Theft Auto VI, or GTA 6, is trending in Australia. Rockstar Games has announced an extended look at the game, and in a unique collaboration, Netflix will host the first major look at GTA 6.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look
GTA VI teams up with Netflix for first-of-its-kind deal
This is not a drill: the next GTA 6 trailer is dropping 27 August… on Netflix

sections.heading: GTA 6 Announcement
paragraphs: According to Rockstar Games, they have released an extended look at the upcoming video game Grand Theft Auto VI, commonly known as GTA 6.

sections.heading: Netflix Collaboration
paragraphs: In a first-of-its-kind deal, as reported by Nine.com.au, Netflix will be the platform where gamers can get their first major look at GTA 6.

sections.heading: Trailer Release
paragraphs: Top Gear has confirmed that the next GTA 6 trailer is set to drop on the 27th of August, and it will be available on Netflix.

faq.a: GTA 6, or Grand Theft Auto VI, is the upcoming installment in the popular Grand Theft Auto video game series.

faq.q: How can I watch the GTA 6 trailer?
faq.a: According to Top Gear, the next GTA 6 trailer will be available on Netflix on the 27th of August.

faq.q: Is there a collaboration with Netflix for GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes, as reported by Nine.com.au, Netflix has teamed up with Rockstar Games to provide the first major look at GTA 6.
